Summary

The European Accessibility Act (EAA) establishes common accessibility requirements for digital products and services in the EU, impacting software procurement and usage. ONLYOFFICE is actively addressing these requirements by preparing an Accessibility Conformance Statement that outlines its current accessibility features, areas for improvement, and plans for formal assessments. This approach aims to ensure that users with disabilities can effectively utilize its document editing tools.

  • The EAA aims to reduce accessibility barriers in the EU.
  • Current ONLYOFFICE's accessibility features include language support, interface scaling and others.
  • Future work focuses on enhancing screen reader support.
  • Accessibility is integrated into the product development lifecycle.

Accessibility requirements for digital products are becoming increasingly important across Europe. For organizations choosing software, accessibility is no longer simply an additional product feature. It can be part of procurement requirements, institutional policies and, depending on the product or service concerned, legal obligations.

For document editing software, the question is particularly complex. A productivity suite is used for much more than entering text. Users navigate toolbars and menus, work with tables and spreadsheets, create presentations, fill in forms, edit PDFs, collaborate with colleagues and move between different types of content. An accessibility barrier in any of these workflows can prevent someone from completing an otherwise routine task.

As part of its ongoing accessibility work, ONLYOFFICE is preparing an Accessibility Conformance Statement describing the accessibility capabilities currently available in its editors, the areas where support is still being expanded and the company’s approach to formal conformance assessment. The document is intended to provide a clearer picture for users and organizations evaluating ONLYOFFICE, particularly those with accessibility requirements.

What is the European Accessibility Act?

The European Accessibility Act (EAA) is Directive (EU) 2019/882, adopted to establish common accessibility requirements for certain products and services in the European Union.

The Directive covers a defined range of products and services, including consumer computer hardware and operating systems, e-books and dedicated software, e-commerce services, consumer banking services and certain electronic communications and transport-related services. The requirements have applied from 28 June 2025 for products and services within its scope.

The purpose of the legislation is broader than requiring individual interface elements to be accessible. It aims to reduce barriers created by different accessibility requirements across EU Member States and improve the accessibility of products and services for people with disabilities.

Whether a particular software product or deployment falls within the exact scope of the EAA depends on the product, service, economic operator and use case. This is particularly relevant for software such as office and document editors, which can be delivered in different ways and as part of different services.

For this reason, organizations should assess their own legal and procurement requirements rather than treating the presence of an accessibility statement as, by itself, proof of legal compliance.

EAA, EN 301 549 and WCAG: what is the difference?

These terms are often used together, but they are not interchangeable. The EAA is European legislation. It establishes accessibility requirements for the products and services covered by the Directive.

EN 301 549 is a European technical standard covering accessibility requirements for ICT products and services. The currently harmonized version, EN 301 549 v3.2.1, draws heavily on WCAG 2.1 but also includes requirements that are not part of WCAG.

WCAG, or the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, is a set of accessibility guidelines developed by the W3C. WCAG 2.1 organizes accessibility requirements around four principles: content and interfaces should be perceivable, operable, understandable and robust.

This distinction matters when assessing software. Meeting individual WCAG criteria does not automatically mean that a product has demonstrated conformity with every applicable requirement of EN 301 549. Likewise, publishing an accessibility feature list is not the same as completing a formal accessibility audit.

A useful conformance process therefore needs to identify the applicable requirements, test the relevant product workflows and document the results.

Why document editors present a particular accessibility challenge

A modern office suite is effectively a collection of complex applications. Consider a document editor. A user may need to navigate headings, tables, comments, links, footnotes, images and other objects. A spreadsheet adds a two-dimensional grid, formulas, charts, filters and data structures. A presentation editor introduces slides, objects, animations and speaker notes.

PDFs present another set of challenges, particularly when users need to annotate documents, navigate pages, complete forms or work with scanned content.

This means that accessibility cannot be evaluated only by checking whether a product has a “high contrast mode” or whether a particular button can be reached using the keyboard. The entire workflow needs to be considered.

What accessibility features are already available in ONLYOFFICE?

ONLYOFFICE already provides a number of mechanisms intended to make its editors more adaptable to different users.

For visual accessibility, the editors provide scaling presets from 50% to 500%, together with options to fit the editing area to the page or screen width. Users can also hide interface elements such as the toolbar, status bar and rulers when they want to reduce visual complexity.

The editors provide light and dark interface themes, while chart elements can use geometric patterns and other distinctions instead of relying exclusively on color.

Language is another part of accessibility. ONLYOFFICE supports more than 25 interface languages, and the interface language can be configured independently from the document language.

The editors also support right-to-left and bidirectional text, allowing users to work with languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu without having to restructure their content around the limitations of a left-to-right interface.

Keyboard interaction is supported across important parts of the editors, while the Speech Input plugin provides an alternative way to enter text.

On mobile platforms, accessibility capabilities include support for technologies such as VoiceOver and Dynamic Type on iOS and TalkBack on Android.

These features do not by themselves establish full conformance with a particular accessibility standard. They are individual parts of a broader accessibility approach.

Where is accessibility work still needed?

One of the most important parts of an accessibility statement is documenting what is not yet complete.

For ONLYOFFICE, screen reader support remains an active area of development. The company is working toward broader support for NVDA and JAWS on Windows and VoiceOver on macOS across the document, spreadsheet, presentation and PDF editors.

Keyboard accessibility is also being extended. In particular, the PDF editor and form-filling interfaces currently have more limited keyboard accessibility than the document and spreadsheet editors. Other areas being explored include dyslexia-friendly font options and reduced-motion settings.

Being explicit about these limitations is important for organizations evaluating software. Accessibility requirements can differ considerably between users, and a feature that is sufficient for one workflow may not be sufficient for another.

Why ONLYOFFICE is preparing a formal conformance assessment

The next step is formal evaluation. ONLYOFFICE is working toward a WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility audit across its editors and preparing a VPAT / Accessibility Conformance Report for procurement purposes. A formal report provides a different level of information from a general accessibility statement.

Instead of simply saying that a product supports keyboard navigation or screen readers, an Accessibility Conformance Report can examine individual accessibility criteria and indicate whether they are supported, partially supported, not supported or not applicable, according to the assessment methodology.

For organizations, this type of documentation can make accessibility evaluation much more practical. Procurement and IT teams can compare specific requirements against the product rather than relying on broad accessibility claims. It also creates a clearer development target for the product team.

Accessibility is a product-development process

One reason accessibility work can take time in complex productivity software is that accessibility needs to be considered whenever the product changes.

A new editor feature can introduce new keyboard interactions. A redesigned toolbar can affect navigation. A new dialog can require additional screen reader information. A new PDF workflow can create new requirements around forms and focus management.

Accessibility therefore cannot be treated as a one-time checklist completed at the end of development. It needs to be part of the product lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, feedback and subsequent releases.

This is also why formal conformance work and user feedback complement each other. An audit provides a structured assessment against defined criteria, while users can reveal practical barriers that may not become obvious during a limited test scenario.

What the Accessibility Conformance Statement provides

The new ONLYOFFICE Accessibility Conformance Statement brings these elements together.

It documents the accessibility capabilities currently available, identifies known limitations, describes the areas under active development and explains the company’s approach to formal assessment against recognized accessibility standards. It is deliberately not presented as a blanket claim of full compliance.

For organizations with specific accessibility requirements, the most useful information is often not simply whether a product has an accessibility label, but which workflows are supported, which limitations remain and what evidence is available. That is the purpose of the statement.

Looking ahead

The accessibility work at ONLYOFFICE will continue beyond the publication of this document.

The priorities include broader screen reader support, expanded keyboard navigation, additional options for users with different cognitive and visual needs, and formal evaluation against the relevant accessibility requirements.

The broader objective is straightforward: people should be able to create, edit, review and collaborate on documents using the interaction methods and assistive technologies that work for them.

For software used every day in education, business, government and other organizations, that is not a secondary consideration. It is part of what makes a digital workplace usable in the first place.

contentHtml:
Our Back to school series continues with stories from students and young professionals who combine their studies with their first steps into the working world.

Aboubacar Kaba joined ONLYOFFICE while studying Information Systems and Technologies. In this interview, he talks about combining work with his master’s degree, his experience in the Customer Care department, and what changed when he became a full-time team member.

Student life

What were you studying when you joined ONLYOFFICE?

I was studying Information Systems and Technologies, and I joined ONLYOFFICE while still juggling coursework.

What inspired you to apply for an internship or student position here?

What inspired and motivated me to work at ONLYOFFICE is the opportunity to work on an international project.

What was your first impression of ONLYOFFICE?

Bigger than I expected, in a good way. I had no idea such a powerful editor existed, with so many collaborative features.

Balancing work and studies

How did you balance classes, assignments, and work responsibilities?

Honestly, it was more complicated than I imagined at the beginning. Afterwards, I started organizing my time better and eventually got used to the mix of work and university.

What was the biggest challenge during that period?

My biggest challenge was my final year of my master’s degree, because I had to finalize my thesis while working at ONLYOFFICE at the same time. In the end, everything turned out fine.

Did working while studying help you become more organized or disciplined? How?

Absolutely. I improved my sense of organization and learned to prioritize tasks. I also discovered several apps that helped me manage my time better.

Growth journey

What skills did you develop the most while working here?

I learned a lot within the Demo/Academy team, whether it was product presentation, systems architecture, or even automation and workflows.

Looking back, what project or achievement are you most proud of?

I’m proud of many things I’ve done here, but one of the best moments was when we launched the ONLYOFFICE Academy courses.

Was there a moment when you realized you wanted to continue your career at ONLYOFFICE?

From the first few months on, I had the feeling that I’d finally found a job where I truly felt good.

Transition to full-time job

How did it feel to transition from being a student employee to a full-time team member?

More satisfying than I expected. It’s still recent, but being able to focus purely on work makes things simpler.

What has changed the most since your student days?

More free time. When I get home now, I can think about going out without worrying about exams or anything else.

If you could go back and give your student self one piece of advice, what would it be?

I’d tell myself to take more initiative and to prepare mentally for the final evaluations and exams in the master’s program.

ONLYOFFICE experience

What makes ONLYOFFICE a great place for students or young professionals?

The chance to grow, the freedom to be creative, and the fact that any idea to improve our work or ONLYOFFICE itself is always welcome. Most importantly, the atmosphere in my department is genuinely pleasant.

How has the team supported your learning and professional growth?

In the best possible way. People here were generous with their time in a way I didn’t take for granted, answering questions, reviewing my code without making me feel small about the mistakes in it, and pointing me toward the right resources instead of just the right answer.

What’s your favorite part of working here today?

Knowing that clients are happy and that they realize ONLYOFFICE is the best solution for them.

Fun & personal

Describe your journey at ONLYOFFICE in three words.

Everything starts in the morning: as soon as I arrive, I check my email to see if I’ve received any new tasks or if a client has sent something. Then I go grab a coffee au lait during my break. After that, it depends on the day: either I have demos scheduled, or I work through the tasks assigned to me.

Coffee or tea during exam season?

100% coffee (Latte).

What was your go-to study playlist or productivity hack?

Listening to classical music always calms me down and helps me stay concentrated on my work.

Which ONLYOFFICE feature or tool did you use the most as a student?

The collaboration features are definitely my favorites. Being able to work on and edit PDFs is another one, and I also frequently use plugins, both custom ones and the preinstalled ones, to help with my workflow.

What’s one memory from your student days at ONLYOFFICE that still makes you smile?

One memory is the day I went back and forth several times between the office and the university. It didn’t make me smile that day, but looking back on it now, it does.

Advice for students

What advice would you give students who are thinking about applying for internships or student positions?

My only advice is to come join the ONLYOFFICE family. I’m sure you won’t regret it.

Why shouldn’t students wait until graduation to gain work experience?

Working and studying at the same time lets you gain experience before your studies are even finished. By working at ONLYOFFICE during that time, you also gain experience and face real challenges every day.

What would you say to someone starting their first day at ONLYOFFICE?

Nobody expects you to know everything. Ask the question that feels too basic to ask. It usually isn’t.

Start your career at ONLYOFFICE

Starting work before graduation can be a good way to test your skills, discover what kind of work suits you, and gain experience before entering the job market full-time.

At ONLYOFFICE, students and young professionals can join an international team, work on real projects, and learn alongside experienced colleagues. If you’re looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience while studying, take a look at our open positions.

Điều gì đã truyền cảm hứng để bạn ứng tuyển vào vị trí thực tập sinh tại đây?

Điều thực sự thúc đẩy tôi là cơ hội được đóng góp trực tiếp vào một dự án phần mềm mã nguồn mở mang tầm vóc quốc tế. Được làm việc trong một môi trường đa văn hóa và tiếp xúc với hàng triệu người dùng toàn cầu là ước mơ lớn nhất của tôi khi còn là sinh viên.

Ấn tượng đầu tiên của bạn về ONLYOFFICE như thế nào?

Lớn hơn rất nhiều so với những gì tôi tưởng tượng, theo nghĩa vô cùng tích cực! Trước đó tôi chưa từng nghĩ một bộ biên tập tài liệu trực tuyến lại có thể mạnh mẽ, mượt mà và sở hữu nhiều tính năng cộng tác nhóm chuyên sâu đến như vậy.

Cân bằng giữa công việc và việc học

Làm thế nào để bạn vừa tham gia lớp học, làm bài tập lớn, vừa hoàn thành trách nhiệm công việc?

Thành thật mà nói, thời gian đầu phức tạp hơn tôi nghĩ. Nhưng sau đó tôi học cách quản lý thời gian khoa học hơn, lên kế hoạch chi tiết từng tuần và dần quen với nhịp độ kết hợp giữa giảng đường và công sở.

Thách thức lớn nhất trong suốt giai đoạn đó là gì?

Thử thách lớn nhất là năm cuối chương trình Thạc sĩ, vì tôi phải hoàn thành luận văn tốt nghiệp song song với các dự án kỹ thuật tại ONLYOFFICE. Nhờ sự hỗ trợ tận tình từ các anh chị đồng nghiệp và tinh thần kỷ luật, cuối cùng mọi thứ đều hoàn thành xuất sắc.

Việc vừa học vừa làm có giúp bạn trở nên ngăn nắp và kỷ luật hơn không?

Chắc chắn là có. Tôi nâng cao đáng kể kỹ năng tổ chức và học được cách phân loại nhiệm vụ ưu tiên (task prioritization). Tôi cũng ứng dụng nhiều công cụ công nghệ giúp tối ưu hóa hiệu suất làm việc mỗi ngày.

Hành trình phát triển kỹ năng

Những kỹ năng nào bạn phát triển vượt bậc nhất trong thời gian làm việc tại đây?

Tôi học hỏi được vô số kiến thức quý giá trong đội ngũ Demo và Academy, từ kỹ năng thuyết trình giải pháp, hiểu sâu về kiến trúc phần mềm đám mây, đến tự động hóa quy trình làm việc (workflows) và giải quyết sự cố kỹ thuật cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp.

Nhìn lại, bạn tự hào nhất về thành tựu nào?

Tôi tự hào về rất nhiều điều, đặc biệt là khi nhận được những phản hồi cảm ơn chân thành từ khách hàng khi tôi giúp họ giải quyết vướng mắc kỹ thuật. Điều tự hào nhất là tôi đã được ký hợp đồng lập trình viên chính thức ngay sau khi nhận bằng tốt nghiệp.

Lời khuyên dành cho thế hệ sinh viên tiếp nối

Bạn có lời khuyên nào gửi đến các bạn sinh viên muốn xây dựng sự nghiệp công nghệ ngay từ trên ghế nhà trường?

Đừng bao giờ đợi đến khi tốt nghiệp mới bắt đầu tìm kiếm cơ hội. Hãy chủ động tham gia các cộng đồng mã nguồn mở, mạnh dạn ứng tuyển vào những công ty công nghệ chuyên nghiệp như ONLYOFFICE và đừng ngại đặt câu hỏi. Khi bạn có đam mê và sự chủ động, mọi cánh cửa nghề nghiệp sẽ rộng mở.

Our Back to school series continues with stories from students and young professionals who combine their studies with their first steps into the working world.

Aboubacar Kaba joined ONLYOFFICE while studying Information Systems and Technologies. In this interview, he talks about combining work with his master’s degree, his experience in the Customer Care department, and what changed when he became a full-time team member.

Student life

What were you studying when you joined ONLYOFFICE?

I was studying Information Systems and Technologies, and I joined ONLYOFFICE while still juggling coursework.

What inspired you to apply for an internship or student position here?

What inspired and motivated me to work at ONLYOFFICE is the opportunity to work on an international project.

What was your first impression of ONLYOFFICE?

Bigger than I expected, in a good way. I had no idea such a powerful editor existed, with so many collaborative features.

Balancing work and studies

How did you balance classes, assignments, and work responsibilities?

Honestly, it was more complicated than I imagined at the beginning. Afterwards, I started organizing my time better and eventually got used to the mix of work and university.

What was the biggest challenge during that period?

My biggest challenge was my final year of my master’s degree, because I had to finalize my thesis while working at ONLYOFFICE at the same time. In the end, everything turned out fine.

Did working while studying help you become more organized or disciplined? How?

Absolutely. I improved my sense of organization and learned to prioritize tasks. I also discovered several apps that helped me manage my time better.

Growth journey

What skills did you develop the most while working here?

I learned a lot within the Demo/Academy team, whether it was product presentation, systems architecture, or even automation and workflows.

Looking back, what project or achievement are you most proud of?

I’m proud of many things I’ve done here, but one of the best moments was when we launched the ONLYOFFICE Academy courses.

Was there a moment when you realized you wanted to continue your career at ONLYOFFICE?

From the first few months on, I had the feeling that I’d finally found a job where I truly felt good.

Transition to full-time job

How did it feel to transition from being a student employee to a full-time team member?

More satisfying than I expected. It’s still recent, but being able to focus purely on work makes things simpler.

What has changed the most since your student days?

More free time. When I get home now, I can think about going out without worrying about exams or anything else.

If you could go back and give your student self one piece of advice, what would it be?

I’d tell myself to take more initiative and to prepare mentally for the final evaluations and exams in the master’s program.

ONLYOFFICE experience

What makes ONLYOFFICE a great place for students or young professionals?

The chance to grow, the freedom to be creative, and the fact that any idea to improve our work or ONLYOFFICE itself is always welcome. Most importantly, the atmosphere in my department is genuinely pleasant.

How has the team supported your learning and professional growth?

In the best possible way. People here were generous with their time in a way I didn’t take for granted, answering questions, reviewing my code without making me feel small about the mistakes in it, and pointing me toward the right resources instead of just the right answer.

What’s your favorite part of working here today?

Knowing that clients are happy and that they realize ONLYOFFICE is the best solution for them.

Fun & personal

Describe your journey at ONLYOFFICE in three words.

Everything starts in the morning: as soon as I arrive, I check my email to see if I’ve received any new tasks or if a client has sent something. Then I go grab a coffee au lait during my break. After that, it depends on the day: either I have demos scheduled, or I work through the tasks assigned to me.

Coffee or tea during exam season?

100% coffee (Latte).

What was your go-to study playlist or productivity hack?

Listening to classical music always calms me down and helps me stay concentrated on my work.

Which ONLYOFFICE feature or tool did you use the most as a student?

The collaboration features are definitely my favorites. Being able to work on and edit PDFs is another one, and I also frequently use plugins, both custom ones and the preinstalled ones, to help with my workflow.

What’s one memory from your student days at ONLYOFFICE that still makes you smile?

One memory is the day I went back and forth several times between the office and the university. It didn’t make me smile that day, but looking back on it now, it does.

Advice for students

What advice would you give students who are thinking about applying for internships or student positions?

My only advice is to come join the ONLYOFFICE family. I’m sure you won’t regret it.

Why shouldn’t students wait until graduation to gain work experience?

Working and studying at the same time lets you gain experience before your studies are even finished. By working at ONLYOFFICE during that time, you also gain experience and face real challenges every day.

What would you say to someone starting their first day at ONLYOFFICE?

Nobody expects you to know everything. Ask the question that feels too basic to ask. It usually isn’t.

Start your career at ONLYOFFICE

Starting work before graduation can be a good way to test your skills, discover what kind of work suits you, and gain experience before entering the job market full-time.

At ONLYOFFICE, students and young professionals can join an international team, work on real projects, and learn alongside experienced colleagues. If you’re looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience while studying, take a look at our open positions.

author: Dasha
contentHtml:
Our Back to school series is not only about returning to classes but also about people who balance studying with their first professional experience and gradually turn what they learn into real skills.

For many students, having a job while studying can be challenging. Classes, assignments, exams, and work all have to fit into the same week. However, working on real projects can change how you view your studies and give you a clearer idea of where you want to go professionally.

In this interview, Aleksandr shares what it was like to combine university life with development work, what he learned from working with a large codebase, and how he eventually moved into a full-time role.

Student life

What were you studying when you joined ONLYOFFICE?

I studied computer systems and technology. By the time I joined ONLYOFFICE, I started my third year.

What inspired you to apply for an internship or student position here?

I wanted to do more than just write code for the sake of writing code. I wanted to work on a product that people actually use.

What was your first impression of ONLYOFFICE?

I was surprised that I was given real tasks right away instead of being told to spend a month reading documentation. It was also easy to ask anyone a question.

Balancing work and studies

How did you balance classes, assignments, and work responsibilities?

Honestly, not always perfectly. A flexible schedule helped: I had classes during the day, and my work could be adjusted around them. I learned to plan my week in advance. Otherwise, everything would fall apart.

What was the biggest challenge during that period?

Exam session. When you have exams and deadlines for tasks at the same time, you have to set priorities pretty strictly.

Did working while studying help you become more organized or disciplined? How?

Yes, very much. When you don’t have ten free hours a day, you automatically learn not to stretch a single task out over the whole day.

Growth journey

What skills did you develop the most while working here?

Working with a large, existing codebase. You don’t really learn that at university. I also improved my debugging and profiling skills and learned how to read other people’s code.

Looking back, what project or achievement are you most proud of?

The performance optimization tasks. When you see in the profiler that something has become several times faster, it’s a really satisfying feeling.

Was there a moment when you realized you wanted to continue your career at ONLYOFFICE?

When I realized that the tasks had become more interesting to me than my university assignments. I wanted to see them through to the end, not just do them and forget about them.

Transition to full-time

How did it feel to transition from being a student employee to a full-time team member?

Calm, without any stress. I already knew the team, the project, and the processes. The biggest changes were the workload and the responsibility.

What has changed the most since your student days?

I started thinking not only about how to do a task, but also how it would affect the rest of the code and the users.

If you could go back and give your student self one piece of advice, what would it be?

Don’t be afraid to ask “stupid” questions. Half a day of struggling on your own can often be avoided with one message to a colleague.

ONLYOFFICE experience

What makes ONLYOFFICE a great place for students or young professionals?

Real tasks from the first day, a live product, and an understanding that students also have their studies to manage.

How has the team supported your learning and professional growth?

There was always someone I could ask a question. Code reviews here aren’t about tearing your work apart. They’re about explaining why something might be better done differently, and that’s how you learn faster.

What’s your favorite part of working here today?

Seeing the result of your work. You make something, and people actually use it.

Photo by Social Mode on Unsplash

Fun & personal

Describe your journey at ONLYOFFICE in three words.

Study, code, coffee.

Coffee or tea during exam season?

Coffee.

What was your go-to study playlist or productivity hack?

No music with lyrics, just ambient or lo-fi. As for productivity hacks, I use a 45-minute timer and keep my phone in another room.

Which ONLYOFFICE feature or tool did you use the most as a student?

The Spreadsheet Editor, both for studying and preparing reports, as well as for my own calculations.

What’s one memory from your student days at ONLYOFFICE that still makes you smile?

My first task that made it into a release. I specifically opened the build afterwards to see how it worked for users.

Advice for students

What advice would you give students who are thinking about applying for internships or student positions?

Don’t wait until you “grow into it.” Nobody expects perfect code from a student. They expect a willingness to figure things out.

Why shouldn’t students wait until graduation to gain work experience?

After graduation, you’re competing with people who may already have a couple of years of experience. Studying also becomes more meaningful when you can see where what you’re learning is actually used.

What would you say to someone starting their first day at ONLYOFFICE?

Relax. Nobody expects you to perform miracles in your first month. Ask questions, take notes, and don’t be afraid to admit that you didn’t understand something.

Start gaining experience while you study with ONLYOFFICE

At ONLYOFFICE, students and young professionals can take on practical tasks, learn from experienced colleagues, and gain experience while continuing their studies. For those who are ready to give it a try, the first step is simply to apply.

Tiếp nối chuỗi bài viết truyền cảm hứng mùa tựu trường, chúng tôi hân hạnh giới thiệu cuộc trò chuyện với Aleksandr, lập trình viên phần mềm tại ONLYOFFICE – người đã đi từ vị trí thực tập sinh đến kỹ sư chính thức đóng góp vào các module cốt lõi của bộ ứng dụng.

Khởi đầu từ những dòng mã nguồn mở

Aleksandr bắt đầu hành trình của mình khi còn đang theo học chuyên ngành Kỹ thuật Phần mềm. Anh chia sẻ rằng việc tham gia đóng góp cho một sản phẩm office suite với hàng triệu dòng code C++ và JavaScript phức tạp ban đầu là một thử thách choáng ngợp, nhưng cũng là trường học thực tế tuyệt vời nhất.

Môi trường hỗ trợ tân binh tối đa

Tại ONLYOFFICE, mỗi lập trình viên trẻ đều được đồng hành cùng một Senior Mentor. Aleksandr nhấn mạnh: "Không có câu hỏi nào là ngớ ngẩn. Văn hóa review code nghiêm ngặt nhưng cởi mở đã giúp tôi sửa đổi tư duy viết code sạch (clean code) và tối ưu hóa hiệu năng thuật toán."

Từ đồ án tốt nghiệp đến sản phẩm thương mại

Đồ án tốt nghiệp của Aleksandr tập trung vào tối ưu hóa thuật toán render văn bản đồ họa. Những nghiên cứu đó đã được tích hợp trực tiếp vào nhân xử lý của ONLYOFFICE Document Server, giúp tăng tốc độ mở tài liệu nặng lên tới 30%.

title_vi: Plugin Antidote mới cho ONLYOFFICE: Kiểm tra và nâng cao chất lượng văn bản tiếng Anh và Pháp
excerpt_en: Tích hợp công cụ chỉnh sửa ngữ pháp và phong cách văn bản hàng đầu thế giới Antidote trực tiếp vào giao diện soạn thảo tài liệu ONLYOFFICE.
excerpt_vi: Tích hợp công cụ chỉnh sửa ngữ pháp và phong cách văn bản hàng đầu thế giới Antidote trực tiếp vào giao diện soạn thảo tài liệu ONLYOFFICE.
author: Dasha
contentHtml:
Summary

The new Antidote plugin for ONLYOFFICE allows users to check and improve their texts in English and French directly within the ONLYOFFICE editors. This integration eliminates the need to switch between applications, enabling users to proofread, reformulate, and access language resources seamlessly while maintaining document formatting.

  • The plugin connects ONLYOFFICE with Antidote software.
  • It checks grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style.
  • Users can access dictionaries and guides for language support.
  • The plugin is free to install but requires an Antidote account.
  • It works with Document Editor and Spreadsheet Editor.

Proofreading a document often means switching between your editor and a separate language tool. You copy text, check it, go back to the document, make changes, and repeat the process. At our users’ request, the new Antidote plugin brings this part of the workflow into ONLYOFFICE.

Discover what the plugin offers and how to install and use it in our article from the back to school series.

About the Antidote plugin

The new Antidote plugin connects ONLYOFFICE with Antidote, a linguistic software package for English and French.

Antidote can be used to review and improve your text eight in the editors beyond basic spell-checking. Its Corrector checks grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style, and its Dictionaries and Guides give more information about words and language use.

With the plugin, you can:

  • Verify the whole document or a part of it;
  • Correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language issues;
  • Detect hidden repetitions and style problems;
  • Get suggestions for clearer and more precise wording;
  • Find suitable synonyms;
  • Look up words in Antidote’s Dictionaries and Guides.

How to use the Antidote plugin for ONLYOFFICE

The Antidote plugin adds three basic tools directly in ONLYOFFICE:

  • Corrector – to proofread your text;
  • Dictionaries – to check individual words;
  • Guides – to get additional information about language and writing.

How to check and correct your text

Use Corrector to verify your text for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and style mistakes. It can also detect repetitions and give you tips on how to improve your language.

1. Open the Antidote plugin in the Plugins tab.

2. Select the part of the text you want to check. To check the entire document, make sure the Whole document option is selected in the left-side panel.

3. Click Corrector to launch the analysis. The Antidote window will open with the analysis of your text.

4. Review the issues detected by Antidote and apply the suggested corrections where needed. Accepted changes will be automatically applied to your document in ONLYOFFICE editor.

You can also switch between the Antidote tabs to review different aspects of your text:

  • Typography checks quotation marks, spacing, capitalization and other typographic details;
  • Style deals with word choice and style issues that may affect how clear your writing is;
  • Anti-Oups catches small mistakes and oversights that are easy to miss during proofreading;
  • Spelling detects and suggests corrections for misspelled words;
  • Grammar finds grammar errors and suggest corrections;
  • Punctuation checks commas, periods, and other punctuation marks;
  • Repetitions identifies repeated words and phrases;
  • Vocabulary spots imprecise or inappropriate word choices.

With the Antidote plugin, you don’t need to switch between applications, copy your text into a separate tool, and paste it back into ONLYOFFICE. There is no need to restore the formatting afterwards either. When you accept a correction in the Antidote window, the change is automatically applied to the document in the ONLYOFFICE editor.

How to reformulate your text with Antidote

In the same way, you can reformulate and find precise wording with Antidote.

1. Select the word or phrase you want to reformulate. Or, do not use the selection to reformulate the whole text.

2. Click Corrector, switch to the Reformulation tab, and explore the available alternatives for your phrases.

3. Accept the options that fit your context.

The selected phrases are replaced directly in the ONLYOFFICE editor, while the rest of your document formatting remains unchanged.

How to use Dictionaries with Antidote

Use Dictionaries to check definitions, find synonyms, and explore different meanings of words directly from your document.

1. Select the word you want to look up.

2. Click Dictionaries and explore the available definitions, synonyms, and other information about the selected word.

How to use Guides with Antidote

Guides provide detailed information about grammar, spelling, punctuation, style, and other aspects of English and French writing. They can help you better understand language rules, compare different ways of expressing an idea, and make more informed editing decisions.

Use Guides to clarify a language question, check whether a construction is appropriate, or improve the accuracy and style of your text. The relevant information is displayed directly in the Antidote window, so you can consult it without leaving the ONLYOFFICE editor.

How to install and configure the plugin

Before installing the plugin, make sure you meet the following requirements:

  • ONLYOFFICE 9.3.0 or later (cloud, self-hosted, or desktop versions);
  • Antidote 12;
  • Connectix, a local service provided by Antidote.

Install the plugin in ONLYOFFICE

The Antidote plugin can be installed in ONLYOFFICE.

1. Open an ONLYOFFICE editor and go to the Plugins tab.

2. Click the Plugin Manager.

3. Find Antidote in the list and click Install.

Once installed, the plugin will be available from the Plugins tab.

Connect the plugin to Antidote

The setup depends on where the editors and Antidote are running:

  • Desktop Editors: Antidote 12 on the same computer as ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors. When you open the plugin, it automatically detects the local Antidote service and connects to it.
  • Server: For self-hosted ONLYOFFICE Docs, install the plugin on the same server that hosts the editors and Antidote. When the plugin starts, it automatically connects to the local Antidote service.
  • Browser: In some browsers, notably Chrome 142 and later, access to the page may be restricted. If this happens, install the plugin on the server hosting ONLYOFFICE Docs or use ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors with Antidote installed locally.

If the port cannot be detected automatically, enter it manually in the plugin’s Settings.

Once the connection is established, you can check your text with Corrector or look up words in Dictionaries and Guides.

The Antidote plugin brings advanced language checking directly into ONLYOFFICE. You can review your English and French texts, correct grammar and spelling issues, improve style, and look up words without copying your text to another application.

Yes. You need an Antidote account and the Antidote 12 application installed and running locally.

Yes, the Antidote plugin for ONLYOFFICE is free to install and use. However, Antidote is a paid linguistic software package. If you want to try it before purchasing, you can use the 30-day free trial offered by Antidote.

contentHtml:
Summary

During ONLYOFFICE's 16th anniversary celebration, the company addressed various questions from users, providing insights into features, integrations, and future developments. This blog post answers 16 key questions, reflecting user feedback and highlighting the platform's capabilities, including AI integration, document compatibility, and educational tools, while encouraging community engagement for further enhancements.

  • ONLYOFFICE supports custom AI provider integrations.
  • Users can request additional AI features via community feedback.
  • The platform is free and accessible for students.
  • ONLYOFFICE is natively compatible with Microsoft Office formats.
  • The suite offers real-time collaboration for group projects.

During the celebration of ONLYOFFICE’s 16th anniversary, we have received a lot of questions from our users via our community forum and social media. Although many questions were feature requests, some of them provided valuable feedback for our team. That’s why we would like to share our answers to 16 questions and suggestions in this blog post. Why 16? Because ONLYOFFICE has turned 16 this month.

16 years of ONLYOFFICE: all you need to know

Before we dive into questions and answers, we recommend you get familiar with our 16th anniversary blog series. It will walk you through the history of our triumphs and controversial decisions, introduce the people behind our project, bring to light the features that shaped ONLYOFFICE and even reveal what we are going to build in the next 16 years.

AI integration

Since AI integration has been a crucial part of our project so far, many users have questions about how to use artificial intelligence and connect their favourite AI providers in ONLYOFFICE.

Question: With AI assistants becoming a core focus, will ONLYOFFICE support custom AI model integrations so teams can connect their own LLMs instead of being limited to built-in ones?

Answer: We already support custom AI providers in our AI integration. Apart from the predefined options, such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral and more, our users can configure and connect any custom AI provider, using the corresponding functionality in our plugin. Such an approach reflects our philosophy — giving users total control over their AI integration and allowing them to use the tools they can rely on.

Question: Question: Is it possible to integrate 1min.AI in OnlyOffice Desktop Editors by using API? If not, can this feature be provided in the next upgrade of the AI plugin?

Answer: Currently, we have no plans to add this provider to our AI integration. However, you can request that we make it available in our community. If other users support your suggestion, we might want to change our mind. The more upvotes, the better!

Question: I would like to have an AI agent from European countries. Is it possible?

Answer: Sure thing! Among all compatible AI providers, you can try Mistral AI, a France-based artificial intelligence provider known for its open-source large language models that can be used for all kinds of natural language processing tasks. For more information on how to set it up in our AI plugin, please read this guide in our Help Center or watch the video below:

Question: Some AI operations should be performed asynchronously. For example, when I select a piece of text and ask the AI to translate or rewrite it, I should still be able to continue editing other parts of the content, instead of being stuck on the progress bar screen. Will you implement it?

Answer: We have good news for you! This feature is expected to be available in version 10.0 coming out in early autumn. This release will also introduce other AI updates and improvements, making the overall user experience more comfortable. If you want to know the details, take a look at our roadmap and stay tuned!

Integration

Over the years, we have built an ecosystem with more than 40 ready-to-use integrations and more than 50 plugins. However, our users need more and more integrations for their workflows.

Question: I believe it would be a great enhancement if API users could create document templates that accept parameters when they are opened, allowing the document to automatically render its content based on the provided data. This functionality would make it much easier to generate dynamic documents, reduce manual work, and enable the same template to be reused across multiple scenarios. I believe this would be a valuable feature for developers and organizations integrating ONLYOFFICE through its API.

Answer: For those seeking to integrate our software through its API for better template workflows, ONLYOFFICE Automation API might be the solution. It enables interaction with office documents from external sources, allowing you to automatically fill out form templates outside the editor. A great example of such automation is the ONLYOFFICE Templates app for Odoo. Using this app, users can create form templates and automatically complete their fields with the corresponding Odoo data without manual input.

Possible issues

Sometimes users want to know if they encounter unusual behaviour when using the ONLYOFFICE editors or if there is something they don’t know about.

Question: I’m using your Community version 9.4.0.129 (x64 Flatpak) in Dutch with a German keyboard on an HP ZBook 15 G5 running Mint Cinnamon 22.3. And although Dutch documents are also marked as being in Dutch, whenever I make changes to the text, the language and spell-checking switch to German, and the text is underlined in red. So the keyboard language is interfering with the spell-checker. Is there any hope that this will be fixed in a future version?

Answer: You can try disabling the Spelling language detection option in the Settings section of the start window. If this doesn’t help, please report this issue on GitHub or our community forum as described in this guide.

Question: Regarding ONLYOFFICE Editor for the free version, why is it not capable of typing English characters in Zorin Linux computer?

Answer: Please provide more information, e.g. exact version of your OS, the version of the ONLYOFFICE app, screenshots or videos, etc., and report this issue on GitHub or our community forum. For detailed guidelines on how to report issues, please visit our Help Center.

Format compatibility

With plenty of office suites out there, format compatibility might become a pain because different users prefer different formats for their workflows.

Question: I really hate DOCX because the files always lose formatting and corrupt over time. Why can’t I use ODT? Every time I try to use ODT, it is converted to a DOCX.

Answer: ONLYOFFICE has been natively supporting OOXML (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) formats since 2011, and other popular formats, like ODT, are converted to OOXML upon editing. Although you can expect the highest compatibility with Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, flawless compatibility with ODF is also what we constantly work on and try to improve. To better understand why ONLYOFFICE relies on OOXML, please read this blog post.

Text formatting

One of the most popular question types regards the applicability of the ONLYOFFICE editors in different scenarios and professional spheres. For example:

Question: I know ONLYOFFICE is great for office work. But has anyone here ever tried doing complex layout work, like the style shown below? Is it possible to lay out a book this way?

Image source: Reddit

Answer: Yes, it’s possible. ONLYOFFICE Document Editor provides a vast array of formatting and styling tools, allowing you to create complex layouts for professional purposes. If you want to master ONLYOFFICE documents, please take a look at this guide in our Help Center.

Education

Students and educators often want to know if ONLYOFFICE can be a good fit for them before switching to it. Let’s find out.

Question: Is ONLYOFFICE good enough for students?

Answer: ONLYOFFICE is a good choice for students because it’s designed to make studying and group work easier due to the following features:

  • Free and accessible options: Students can use ONLYOFFICE for free (including a free cloud-based option), so they can create and edit documents without paying for a license;
  • Highest compatibility with Microsoft Office formats: ONLYOFFICE natively supports DOCX, XLSX and PPTX, which helps students open, edit and submit assignments in the formats schools commonly require;
  • AI-powered assistance: The built-in AI tools make it easier for students to complete their assignments right in their documents;
  • Real-time collaboration for group projects: Multiple people can co-edit the same document, spreadsheet, presentation or PDF file with features like comments and change tracking to coordinate their work;
  • Useful academic tools: Built-in features like citation tools, equation editing and plugins for bibliography management (e.g. Zotero and Mendeley) help with research papers;
  • Availability across devices and setups: The suite is available as web, desktop and mobile apps, and can be used in the cloud or self-hosted setups, allowing students to access and edit their files from any device.

Comparison with other office suites

If you have never used ONLYOFFICE, you might wonder what makes it different from other office suites.

Question: What’s the difference between LibreOffice and ONLYOFFICE?

Answer: Although both suites are open-source, the core difference between them lies in their native formats. While LibreOffice sticks to ODF, ONLYOFFICE is natively compatible with OOXML (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) formats. Another distinguishing point is that our office suite is mainly web-based, with additional desktop and mobile apps for a seamless editing experience across various platforms and devices, while LibreOffice is purely suited for desktop environments. Also, many users point out that the ONLYOFFICE interface looks and feels more familiar.

Of course, there are some other differences that make ONLYOFFICE shine, e.g. editing functionality, integration capabilities, collaborative tools and the implementation of AI assistance. For a detailed comparison, please visit this page.

Feature requests

Finally, the most popular question type: feature requests. Since ONLYOFFICE is used by more than 21 million people around the globe, we receive a lot of requests and suggestions every day. Some recent examples:

  • I am very happy with ONLYOFFICE. But when I open it, I never use PPTX. I’d like it to open with only 3 choices: only the usual DOCX, XLSX and PDF. Any chance to alter the start?
  • Why is it not able to be saved automatically while using it?
  • Please add a tracked changes view that shows the document as final text while still allowing editing. This would make ONLYOFFICE much better for serious editing, proofreading, and revision work.
  • Can you add the reuse slide feature in the presentation editor?
  • I just wanted to have a multipage view for PDFs with Desktop Editors 9.3.

We always listen to our users and pay attention to what they want to see implemented in our editors. Over the last 12 months, we have received almost 500 ideas and feature suggestions in our community. As a result, we implemented such highly anticipated features as ARM support for the desktop editors on Windows and Linux, editing password-protected PDF files, custom keyboard shortcuts, multipage view in documents and more.

If you need a certain feature for your workflow or have a suggestion about how to make ONLYOFFICE better, don’t hesitate to share your feedback in our community. Suggest new things, leave comments and vote for other users’ ideas:

Join the ONLYOFFICE community and help us make the best office suite for your and other people. Want to contribute in another way? Explore the contribution opportunities and become part of our project.

Summary

During ONLYOFFICE's 16th anniversary celebration, the company addressed various questions from users, providing insights into features, integrations, and future developments. This blog post answers 16 key questions, reflecting user feedback and highlighting the platform's capabilities, including AI integration, document compatibility, and educational tools, while encouraging community engagement for further enhancements.

  • ONLYOFFICE supports custom AI provider integrations.
  • Users can request additional AI features via community feedback.
  • The platform is free and accessible for students.
  • ONLYOFFICE is natively compatible with Microsoft Office formats.
  • The suite offers real-time collaboration for group projects.

During the celebration of ONLYOFFICE’s 16th anniversary, we have received a lot of questions from our users via our community forum and social media. Although many questions were feature requests, some of them provided valuable feedback for our team. That’s why we would like to share our answers to 16 questions and suggestions in this blog post. Why 16? Because ONLYOFFICE has turned 16 this month.

16 years of ONLYOFFICE: all you need to know

Before we dive into questions and answers, we recommend you get familiar with our 16th anniversary blog series. It will walk you through the history of our triumphs and controversial decisions, introduce the people behind our project, bring to light the features that shaped ONLYOFFICE and even reveal what we are going to build in the next 16 years.

AI integration

Since AI integration has been a crucial part of our project so far, many users have questions about how to use artificial intelligence and connect their favourite AI providers in ONLYOFFICE.

Question: With AI assistants becoming a core focus, will ONLYOFFICE support custom AI model integrations so teams can connect their own LLMs instead of being limited to built-in ones?

Answer: We already support custom AI providers in our AI integration. Apart from the predefined options, such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral and more, our users can configure and connect any custom AI provider, using the corresponding functionality in our plugin. Such an approach reflects our philosophy — giving users total control over their AI integration and allowing them to use the tools they can rely on.

Question: Question: Is it possible to integrate 1min.AI in OnlyOffice Desktop Editors by using API? If not, can this feature be provided in the next upgrade of the AI plugin?

Answer: Currently, we have no plans to add this provider to our AI integration. However, you can request that we make it available in our community. If other users support your suggestion, we might want to change our mind. The more upvotes, the better!

Question: I would like to have an AI agent from European countries. Is it possible?

Answer: Sure thing! Among all compatible AI providers, you can try Mistral AI, a France-based artificial intelligence provider known for its open-source large language models that can be used for all kinds of natural language processing tasks. For more information on how to set it up in our AI plugin, please read this guide in our Help Center or watch the video below:

Question: Some AI operations should be performed asynchronously. For example, when I select a piece of text and ask the AI to translate or rewrite it, I should still be able to continue editing other parts of the content, instead of being stuck on the progress bar screen. Will you implement it?

Answer: We have good news for you! This feature is expected to be available in version 10.0 coming out in early autumn. This release will also introduce other AI updates and improvements, making the overall user experience more comfortable. If you want to know the details, take a look at our roadmap and stay tuned!

Integration

Over the years, we have built an ecosystem with more than 40 ready-to-use integrations and more than 50 plugins. However, our users need more and more integrations for their workflows.

Question: I believe it would be a great enhancement if API users could create document templates that accept parameters when they are opened, allowing the document to automatically render its content based on the provided data. This functionality would make it much easier to generate dynamic documents, reduce manual work, and enable the same template to be reused across multiple scenarios. I believe this would be a valuable feature for developers and organizations integrating ONLYOFFICE through its API.

Answer: For those seeking to integrate our software through its API for better template workflows, ONLYOFFICE Automation API might be the solution. It enables interaction with office documents from external sources, allowing you to automatically fill out form templates outside the editor. A great example of such automation is the ONLYOFFICE Templates app for Odoo. Using this app, users can create form templates and automatically complete their fields with the corresponding Odoo data without manual input.

Possible issues

Sometimes users want to know if they encounter unusual behaviour when using the ONLYOFFICE editors or if there is something they don’t know about.

Question: I’m using your Community version 9.4.0.129 (x64 Flatpak) in Dutch with a German keyboard on an HP ZBook 15 G5 running Mint Cinnamon 22.3. And although Dutch documents are also marked as being in Dutch, whenever I make changes to the text, the language and spell-checking switch to German, and the text is underlined in red. So the keyboard language is interfering with the spell-checker. Is there any hope that this will be fixed in a future version?

Answer: You can try disabling the Spelling language detection option in the Settings section of the start window. If this doesn’t help, please report this issue on GitHub or our community forum as described in this guide.

Question: Regarding ONLYOFFICE Editor for the free version, why is it not capable of typing English characters in Zorin Linux computer?

Answer: Please provide more information, e.g. exact version of your OS, the version of the ONLYOFFICE app, screenshots or videos, etc., and report this issue on GitHub or our community forum. For detailed guidelines on how to report issues, please visit our Help Center.

Format compatibility

With plenty of office suites out there, format compatibility might become a pain because different users prefer different formats for their workflows.

Question: I really hate DOCX because the files always lose formatting and corrupt over time. Why can’t I use ODT? Every time I try to use ODT, it is converted to a DOCX.

Answer: ONLYOFFICE has been natively supporting OOXML (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) formats since 2011, and other popular formats, like ODT, are converted to OOXML upon editing. Although you can expect the highest compatibility with Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, flawless compatibility with ODF is also what we constantly work on and try to improve. To better understand why ONLYOFFICE relies on OOXML, please read this blog post.

Text formatting

One of the most popular question types regards the applicability of the ONLYOFFICE editors in different scenarios and professional spheres. For example:

Question: I know ONLYOFFICE is great for office work. But has anyone here ever tried doing complex layout work, like the style shown below? Is it possible to lay out a book this way?

Image source: Reddit

Answer: Yes, it’s possible. ONLYOFFICE Document Editor provides a vast array of formatting and styling tools, allowing you to create complex layouts for professional purposes. If you want to master ONLYOFFICE documents, please take a look at this guide in our Help Center.

Education

Students and educators often want to know if ONLYOFFICE can be a good fit for them before switching to it. Let’s find out.

Question: Is ONLYOFFICE good enough for students?

Answer: ONLYOFFICE is a good choice for students because it’s designed to make studying and group work easier due to the following features:

  • Free and accessible options: Students can use ONLYOFFICE for free (including a free cloud-based option), so they can create and edit documents without paying for a license;
  • Highest compatibility with Microsoft Office formats: ONLYOFFICE natively supports DOCX, XLSX and PPTX, which helps students open, edit and submit assignments in the formats schools commonly require;
  • AI-powered assistance: The built-in AI tools make it easier for students to complete their assignments right in their documents;
  • Real-time collaboration for group projects: Multiple people can co-edit the same document, spreadsheet, presentation or PDF file with features like comments and change tracking to coordinate their work;
  • Useful academic tools: Built-in features like citation tools, equation editing and plugins for bibliography management (e.g. Zotero and Mendeley) help with research papers;
  • Availability across devices and setups: The suite is available as web, desktop and mobile apps, and can be used in the cloud or self-hosted setups, allowing students to access and edit their files from any device.

Comparison with other office suites

If you have never used ONLYOFFICE, you might wonder what makes it different from other office suites.

Question: What’s the difference between LibreOffice and ONLYOFFICE?

Answer: Although both suites are open-source, the core difference between them lies in their native formats. While LibreOffice sticks to ODF, ONLYOFFICE is natively compatible with OOXML (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) formats. Another distinguishing point is that our office suite is mainly web-based, with additional desktop and mobile apps for a seamless editing experience across various platforms and devices, while LibreOffice is purely suited for desktop environments. Also, many users point out that the ONLYOFFICE interface looks and feels more familiar.

Of course, there are some other differences that make ONLYOFFICE shine, e.g. editing functionality, integration capabilities, collaborative tools and the implementation of AI assistance. For a detailed comparison, please visit this page.

Feature requests

Finally, the most popular question type: feature requests. Since ONLYOFFICE is used by more than 21 million people around the globe, we receive a lot of requests and suggestions every day. Some recent examples:

  • I am very happy with ONLYOFFICE. But when I open it, I never use PPTX. I’d like it to open with only 3 choices: only the usual DOCX, XLSX and PDF. Any chance to alter the start?
  • Why is it not able to be saved automatically while using it?
  • Please add a tracked changes view that shows the document as final text while still allowing editing. This would make ONLYOFFICE much better for serious editing, proofreading, and revision work.
  • Can you add the reuse slide feature in the presentation editor?
  • I just wanted to have a multipage view for PDFs with Desktop Editors 9.3.

We always listen to our users and pay attention to what they want to see implemented in our editors. Over the last 12 months, we have received almost 500 ideas and feature suggestions in our community. As a result, we implemented such highly anticipated features as ARM support for the desktop editors on Windows and Linux, editing password-protected PDF files, custom keyboard shortcuts, multipage view in documents and more.

If you need a certain feature for your workflow or have a suggestion about how to make ONLYOFFICE better, don’t hesitate to share your feedback in our community. Suggest new things, leave comments and vote for other users’ ideas:

author: Dasha
contentHtml:
As ONLYOFFICE celebrates its 16th anniversary, we’ve spent the past few weeks looking back in our series of stories: remembering the early days of SaaS, revisiting the moments that shaped our products, and talking about the people behind the code.

But anniversaries are also a good time to ask a different question: what comes next?

If the last sixteen years have taught us anything, it’s that predicting the future of technology is nearly impossible. Few people could have imagined cloud collaboration becoming the norm, or AI finding its way into almost every productivity tool. We don’t know exactly what office software will look like in 2042. But we do know what we’re building toward.

AI that works the way you do

AI is quickly becoming part of everyday work. People don’t just want an assistant that can generate text anymore. They expect AI to help them complete real tasks.

Today, users can generate and summarize text, translate content, explain formulas, create code, and configure custom AI assistants for recurring tasks directly inside the editors.

AI in ONLYOFFICE already supports a growing ecosystem of AI providers, including OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, Ollama, DeepSeek, Together AI, Groq, and many others. Users can even connect their own local models and keep everything entirely on their own infrastructure.

We’re even more excited about where these capabilities are heading. We want AI to work directly with the content in your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and forms, understand the context of what you’re working on, help structure information, and automate repetitive tasks. Over time, we see AI becoming a more natural part of the editing experience, seamlessly integrated into everyday workflows rather than existing as a standalone assistant.

In the years ahead, we see it becoming a real assistant for teamwork itself: helping organize collaborative spaces, finding information across files, managing knowledge, and making it easier to navigate growing collections of documents in ONLYOFFICE DocSpace.

We’re building an intelligent workspace where documents, data, and collaboration become easier to manage, while people remain in control of how AI works and which models power it.

Security and control by design

Security has always been one of the foundations of ONLYOFFICE. Over the years, we’ve introduced self-hosted deployment, end-to-end encryption, JWT support, granular access permissions, and open-source transparency that allows organizations to know exactly what they’re running.

And we’re continuing in the same direction. As collaboration becomes more distributed and organizations pay closer attention to data sovereignty, we believe people should have even more control over how and where their information is stored and processed. That’s why security will remain one of the key principles guiding the development of ONLYOFFICE in the years ahead.

Building a larger integration ecosystem

Documents don’t live in isolation. They move between CRM systems, learning platforms, customer portals, and countless business applications.

That’s why we’re continuing to invest in integration and developer tools. We want ONLYOFFICE to fit naturally into the software people already use every day, also giving developers the freedom to build entirely new experiences around documents and collaboration.

Today, ONLYOFFICE offers more than 40 ready-to-use connectors and more than 30 plugins, and the ecosystem continues to grow.

Coming next:

  • Miro
  • Slack
  • Bitbucket Cloud
  • Discourse
  • Directus
  • n8n

At the same time, our APIs and SDKs make it possible to embed not only the editors themselves but also DocSpace rooms and entire collaborative workspaces into third-party products and services.

The next sixteen years start with version 10.0

This autumn, ONLYOFFICE Docs 10.0 will bring together many of the ideas we’ve been talking about throughout this article. Discover the ONLYOFFICE roadmap on GitHub.

It’s the first glimpse of what we’re building for the next sixteen years: software that is more intelligent, more flexible, and better connected to the way people actually work.

Help shape what’s next

Many of the features in ONLYOFFICE started as ideas from our community. Have a suggestion? Share it in our community, vote for ideas from other users, and help us shape the roadmap for the next sixteen years.

contentHtml:
When you build an office suite, you picture a certain kind of user. A team in a meeting room. A student writing an essay. An accountant deep in a spreadsheet. And yes, those people use ONLYOFFICE every day.

But over 16 years, something wonderful happened. Our tools ended up in places we never planned for, helping people whose work looks nothing like a typical office. Firefighters. Human rights lawyers. Food bank volunteers. Even a skate park crew.

So let’s take a tour of the customers we didn’t expect. These are the stories that remind us why we do this.

When rescue workers need documents too

Firefighters run toward danger. We didn’t think document editing would be part of that job. We were wrong.

The Abensberg Fire Department in Germany uses ONLYOFFICE Docs together with Nextcloud to manage the paperwork behind the heroics. Duty rosters, equipment lists, training schedules, incident reports – all of it needs to be stored centrally and edited by the right people. Instead of juggling scattered files, the team shares and updates everything from one secure place. When a call comes in, the last thing anyone wants is to hunt for a document.

It turns out that saving lives involves a surprising amount of coordination behind the scenes. We’re glad our editors help keep that part running smoothly.

Open source for activists

Some of our most moving stories come from organizations fighting for people who need help.

Equal Rights Beyond Borders works on human rights and refugee law, often handling deeply confidential case files. They chose ONLYOFFICE precisely because they can control their own data. For an organization defending legal rights, keeping documents private isn’t a nice-to-have. It’s the whole point.

In Vietnam, the Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation uses ONLYOFFICE to support young people escaping trafficking and poverty. Their staff can focus on the mission instead of software licenses, working together on the documents that help vulnerable kids build safer futures.

These groups often run on tight budgets and even tighter privacy needs. Open-source, self-hosted tools give them power they couldn’t otherwise afford. That combination of freedom, security, and no cost barrier is exactly why they came to us.

Feeding people, one shared file at a time

Fighting hunger is logistics work. And logistics means documents.

The charitable foundation Food Bank used ONLYOFFICE to help coordinate a campaign that collected food worth 300,000 EUR. Behind that number are spreadsheets tracking donations, documents organizing volunteers, and plans keeping everyone aligned.

In Austria, Foodsharing Austria relies on ONLYOFFICE and Nextcloud to carry out a mission built entirely on sharing, namely rescuing surplus food before it goes to waste. And the Vegan in Leipzig project uses the same combination to keep its community workflows running smoothly.

None of these teams set out to become power users of an office suite. They just needed reliable tools that wouldn’t get in the way of doing good.

The places no one expected

Here’s where things get delightfully unusual.

A skate park. Yes, really. St. Skatepark Zuidlaren in the Netherlands uses ONLYOFFICE to organize its local spot for sports and community activities. Planning sessions, events, and coordination, all handled with the same editors a corporation might use for quarterly reports.

Then there’s the internet. An entire online meme community, GoodAnimemes, turned to ONLYOFFICE to keep its document workflows secure. Memes may be for fun, but running a large community still takes real organization.

Music lovers are covered too. ONLYOFFICE has helped organize music festivals in Germany, wrangling the countless schedules, contracts, and logistics that go into a live event. A sports society leaned on ONLYOFFICE to push through the challenges of the pandemic and keep its members connected.

Image source: u-run.fr

And let’s not forget the youth football club that used ONLYOFFICE to coordinate a distributed team of volunteer managers. Anyone who has tried to organize a group of volunteers knows it can feel harder than winning the match itself.

Serving whole cities and countries

Sometimes “unexpected” simply means far-reaching.

In Laos, government officials edit and collaborate on documents through ONLYOFFICE Docs, powering everyday administrative work at a national level. Across the Pacific, the University of French Polynesia made seamless online collaboration a reality for staff and students on a group of islands in the middle of the ocean.

Closer to some of our readers, the city of Hopewell, Virginia adopted ONLYOFFICE to enable remote work for 500 government employees when they suddenly needed it most.

And in Spain, the city council of Reus brought simple, powerful online editing to its public administration.

The city hall of Reus (The image by Josep Llauradó is licensed under CC BY-SA 2.1 ES)

From a small skate park to a national government, the same tools scale to fit. That flexibility is something we’re quietly proud of.

What all these stories have in common

Look closely, and a pattern appears. Fire departments, activists, food banks, festivals, city halls. None of them are “typical” office users. Yet they all needed the same core things:

  • control over their data, especially when handling sensitive or confidential information;
  • tools that fit their budget, whether they’re a global institution or a volunteer group;
  • the freedom of open source, with no lock-in and no compromises;
  • real collaboration that works across distances, devices, and teams.

That’s the quiet magic of building something open and universal. You create a tool for “everyone,” and then everyone shows up, including people you never pictured.

Built for everyone means everyone

When we started, our mission was simple: bring the most innovative office apps to everyone. We meant it as a promise. We didn’t fully grasp just how wide “everyone” would turn out to be.

Today, more than 21 million people use ONLYOFFICE. Some of them are exactly who we expected. Many of them are not, and those are the stories that make us smile the most. A firefighter updating a roster. A lawyer protecting a refugee’s case file. A volunteer sorting donated food. A skater planning the next event.

Each one proves the same point: good tools should serve any mission, big or small, ordinary or extraordinary.

So here’s our question for you: are you one of the customers we didn’t expect?

If ONLYOFFICE plays a surprising role in your work, community, or cause, we’d love to hear about it. You might just become our next favorite example of what “for everyone” really means. Tell us your story
